snippet.title: TUNNELER Alpha Trailer
snippet.description:
TUNNELER is a high-speed roguelike parkour game with a twist: sound reveals the path ahead. Sprint through pitch-black tunnels, chain movement tech for huge combos, avoid traps, and hunt hidden relics while outrunning a relentless cloud of poison gas. Stop moving and lose your vision. How fast can you run in the dark?

Join the Discord for access to the upcoming alpha playtest! https://discord.gg/KbvqNw8afW 🎮

Speedrunners wanted! 🏃‍➡️ Play the alpha today: https://reddley.itch.io/tunneler
